_readme: Enemy types. Each type always fights within its level range: an encounter at stage N uses the types whose range contains N, at level N (clamped into their range). Past the highest range, the toughest types keep appearing at their top level. stats are at the type's lowest level; growthPerLevel is added per level above that. skills: the first one is the basic attack (also used for opportunity attacks). skillsByLevel adds skills from that level up. Monster art is public/art/monsters/<art.kind>.svg (regenerate it with node tools/generate-art.mjs after changing art.color). Human types pick a body model from art.models (bandits have their own: b1-b4) and can use weapons: they get the weapon's stat multipliers and skills (all of them, or only the basic attack with weaponSkillUse = basic), plus weaponSkills for that weapon. threat is how much of the encounter budget one unit uses (the budget is threatPerAdventurer x party size).
